title: AnalysisResult
description: Returned by compute_result() and by inference POST /analyze/{image_id}. 'cells' holds only the cells counted after the border rule, so total_count == len(cells) and abnormal_count == number of cells labelled 'abnormal'. concentration_per_uL = total_count / rectangles_counted * 100 * dilution_factor (Malassez: 100 rectangles = 1 uL), rounded to 2 decimals. confidence = mean of cells[].score rounded to 2 decimals, 0 if no cells (PROPOSED — confirm with team).

cell.description: A counted cell. x, y = centre of its detection box in preprocessed-image pixels (x + w // 2, y + h // 2); label and score come from classify_cell (PROPOSED — confirm with team).
